method: Official New York Fed webpages read using web tool; facts paraphrased, not a byte-identical webpage archive.

facts.core_frequency: monthly, online, roughly balanced weekly collection
facts.rotation: roughly equal numbers join and leave each month
facts.density_aggregation: median of respondent fitted density means

sources.source_sections: Launch, sample size, collection timing, horizons, density versus point prediction, microdata release.

sources.role: official institution and survey landing page

aggregate_release_timing.statement: 通常调查次月公布，确切日期以官方日历为准。
aggregate_release_timing.basis: Existing archived monthly release records, not a claimed fixed day-of-month rule.

selection_reasons: Project judgement: economically important household expectations, transparent questionnaire and probability answers, available demographics and panel observations, usable aggregate and micro validation.
